# enzyme-skill

## Do not edit files here directly

Most files in this repo are synced from [enzyme](https://github.com/byenzyme/enzyme) on every release. Edits made here will be overwritten.

**To make changes, edit the source in byenzyme/enzyme:**

| This repo | Source (byenzyme/enzyme) |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | `agent/SKILL.md` |
| `plugin.yaml` | `agent/plugin.yaml` |
| `*.py` | `agent/*.py` |
| `install.sh` | `agent/install.sh` |
| `README.md` | `agent/README.md` |

**Files managed by CI only (not from agent/):**
- `bin/*` — platform binaries, extracted from build artifacts
- `.gitattributes` — Git LFS tracking rules, repo-level
